from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qs
class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.mail = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        href = dict(attrs).get('href') or ''
        if tag == 'a' and href.lower().startswith('mailto:'):
            url = urlsplit(href)
            query = parse_qs(url.query, keep_blank_values=True)
            self.mail.append((url.path, query.get('subject', [''])[0], query.get('body', [''])[0]))
root = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/bespoke-inbound')
files = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*.html')):
    if 'quote-intake-preview' not in path.parts and path.name != 'live-intake-quote-baseline.html':
        continue
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    parsed = Links()
    parsed.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
    files.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'links': [{'recipient_sha256': hashlib.sha256(recipient.encode()).hexdigest(), 'subject': subject, 'body_line_count': len(body.splitlines()), 'contains_sqlite_identifier': 'site:sqlite-statement-diagnostic' in subject + '\n' + body, 'mentions_quote': any(word in (subject + '\n' + body).casefold() for word in ('quote', 'devis'))} for recipient, subject, body in parsed.mail]})
print(json.dumps({'files': files, 'coverage': 'Committed HTML under the selected directory. Empty inventory means no matching HTML was read. Link structure only. No email client, live mail or terms approval tested.'}, ensure_ascii=False))
